# Setup

```{r everyone load data, message = FALSE}
# this chunk should just work for everyone when you open the project. I copied the data into a subfolder called data within this project, but in case it doesn't work I left Noel and Kelley's load chunks below

source("setup.R")

dynamism_data <- read_csv("data/figures_data/dynamism_data.csv")
data_byyr <- read_csv("data/figures_data/data_byyr.csv") 

all_data_byyr <- read.csv("data/ALL_metrics_07022026.csv") 
```

```{r clean loaded data}
## this should work after you run the right version of data loading above

# dynamism_data <- dynamism_data[1:13,] %>% # for some reason we have duplicate rows in the csv
#   bind_rows( # also want to add back the mod rock_WA site
#     dynamism_data %>% 
#       slice(6) %>% 
#       mutate(across(
#         c(site_reach, site),
#         ~ str_replace_all(.x, "_1", "_2")
#         ))
#     ) 

data_byyr <- data_byyr %>% 
  rename(reach = site,
         site = river) %>% 
  mutate(site_reach = paste0(site,reach,ab)) %>% 
  mutate(ratio_accum_to_ch_area = accum_area/channel_area,
         piece_per_100m = (wood_pieces/channel_length)*100,
         site = factor(site),
         reach = factor(reach))

all_data_byyr <- all_data_byyr %>% 
  rename(reach = site,
         site = river) %>% 
  mutate(site_reach = paste0(site,reach))
```

```{r plot settings}
wood_colors = c("LW_Channel" = "#BEA57D", "no_LW_Channel" = "#99C5B5")#BEA57D
```

# Mean wood bar plot

```{r}

##### mean wood values by site #####
p1 <- dynamism_data %>% 
  group_by(ab) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = name, y = avg_wood_pieces_per100m, fill = reach)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wood_colors,
                    name = "Reach Type",
                    labels = c("Wood rich", "Wood poor")) +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 25)) +
  theme_bw()  +
  labs(y = "Mean # pieces/100 m") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ab),
            position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.9) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

# Wood accumulation area normalized by channel area at each time step, averaged for each site

p2 <- dynamism_data %>% 
  group_by(ab) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = name, y = mean_wood_accum_per_area, fill = reach)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wood_colors,
                    name = "Reach Type",
                    labels = c("Wood rich", "Wood poor")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 25)) +
  theme_bw()  +
  labs(x = "Site",
       y = "Mean wood accumulation area:channel area") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ab),
            position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.9)

mean_wood_by_site <- (p1 / p2)

ggsave(mean_wood_by_site,
       filename = "output/mean_wood_by_site.jpg",
       height = 6.5,
       width = 7,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300)

```

# Wood x time facet wrap

```{r}
acc_over_time <- data_byyr %>% # Cleaned up this plot a bit
  group_by(ab) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = ratio_accum_to_ch_area, color = reach)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = site_reach)) +
  facet_wrap(~name) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wood_colors,
          name = "Reach Type",
          labels = c("Large Wood", "Control")) +
  labs(y = "Wood accumulation : Channel area") + 
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
    theme_bw() +
  geom_text(
    data = data_byyr %>% slice_min(order_by = year, n = 1, by = ab), # first point
    aes(label = ab),
    hjust = 0,        
    nudge_x = -2,     
    show.legend = FALSE)

ggsave(acc_over_time,
       filename = "output/acc_over_time_facet.jpg",
       height = 6,
       width = 7.5,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300)
```

```{r simple dynamism plots PART 2 MEGA PANEL}
##### Sinuosity vs both mean wood metrics #####
p1 <- dynamism_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_wood_pieces_per100m, y = sinuosity_dynamism, color = site)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = reach), size = 3) +
    scale_color_carto_d(palette = "Earth") +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(16, 17),
      labels = c("Large Wood", "Control"),
      name = "Reach Type") +
  geom_line(aes(group = site), color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "Sinuosity",
       color = "Site",
       shape = "Reach Type")
```

##Supplemental

### Acc & Pieces over time
```{r}


# how does standardized wood (the ratio of wood accumulation to channel area and num of pieces per 100 m of channel) change over time?

p1 <- data_byyr %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=piece_per_100m, color = name, shape = reach)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(group = site_reach)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "# of pieces/100 m") +
  geom_text(
    data = data_byyr %>% slice_max(order_by = year, n = 1, by = ab), # first point
    aes(label = ab),
    hjust = 0,        
    nudge_x = 0.2,     
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_discrete(
    name = "Reach type",
    labels = c("Wood rich", "Wood poor")) + # LW is alphabetically before no_LW 
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Site") +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())
# General trend of pieces increasing over time, this is likely an artifact of the imagery resolution improving. Definitely include this in the SI. This is not true for accumulations.

p2 <- data_byyr %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=ratio_accum_to_ch_area, color = name, shape = reach)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(group = site_reach)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Wood accumulation area/channel area") +
  geom_text(
    data = data_byyr %>% slice_max(order_by = year, n = 1, by = ab), # first point
    aes(label = ab),
    hjust = 0,        
    nudge_x = 0.2,     
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

wood_time_si <- (p1/p2)

ggsave(wood_time_si,
       filename = "output/wood_time_si.jpg",
       dpi = 300,
       width = 7,
       height = 6,
       units = "in")
```
